purpose: Records, before any registration or final evaluation, which fresh datasets were downloaded for tt1, what has been seen of them, and which files hold labels. Final-evaluation files are read only through ledgered loaders after the tt1 selection freeze.

hai-20.07.source: github.com/icsdataset/hai at pinned commit 2a814cebc9a66b06c9e5cd545e2d72e65d383737 (git blob hashes verified)
hai-20.07.lineage_status: Never downloaded or used by any earlier FerrumOS study (repository search and all access ledgers, 2026-10-22).
hai-20.07.seen_so_far: Header lines of train1/train2 only (64 columns, ';'-separated, 59 tags; labels attack, attack_P1-P3) and their row counts (309,600 and 241,200). Test files unopened.
hai-20.07.prior_knowledge_disclosure: The author has read summaries of the HAI 1.0 (CSET 2020) paper, which describes this release's attack primitives (setpoint, process-variable and control-output manipulation with replay concealment), and the HAI technical manual. Injection and threshold settings must not use HAI attack targets.

hygrid-ics.seen_so_far: Header line and the first data row of scada_cps_dataset.csv (that row's label fields read Normal/0); the file listing of the code archive, which shows attack script names (e.g. fdi_voltage, coil_manipulation, ramp_attack). No attack script, README attack schedule or attack_labels.csv content has been read.
hygrid-ics.note: Labels are inline; development loaders must exclude the label columns; the train/final split is label-blind and chronological.
